revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: MCI notification identity only: after successful public command open, WAT finalizes the backend MCI_OPEN with the assigned reusable guest slot in MCI_OPEN_PARMS.wDeviceID. The host retains that scalar separately from its monotonically allocated internal device ID and uses it for existing MM_MCINOTIFY posts; direct host and string opens retain the original host ID fallback. No new callback producer, export reentry, scheduler, owner scope, guest context restoration or nonlocal API. Existing pending-notify retirement and post_window_message routing are unchanged; ownership remains pending. Full public A/W x86 command and real queue/DispatchMessage/WndProc success, abort, supersession, no-notify and lower-slot reuse controls: scratch/runs/20261127-mci-notify-id-fix-root. This anchored review preserves the preceding foreign MIDI header mapping WIP without authorizing its integration. 20261127 reanchored over incoming main preserving its reviewed changes.
